segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Hi Hannah, this is Luca from OPSWAT support. I have your case about the Sandbox queue not moving. What are you seeing?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Hi Luca. Since yesterday morning, new files submitted to Sandbox just sit in the queue. Nothing starts analysing, and the queue count keeps climbing. Last week it was fine.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Thanks. Which version of MetaDefender Sandbox is this, and is it a single server?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: We are on Sandbox 2.8.0, a single server install. We haven't upgraded in about four months.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Okay. Have you noticed anything on the server itself, like CPU, memory or disk? A stalled queue is often a resource problem.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Now that you mention it, our monitoring page shows the data drive at ninety-six percent full. CPU and memory look normal.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: That could well be it. Do you know what is using the space on that drive? For example old analysis results, or virtual machine images?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Not exactly. The drive is about five hundred gigabytes. We have kept every analysis report since we installed, so over a year. And there are several analysis VM images from earlier testing that nobody removed.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Did you see any error in the Sandbox log, like a message about disk space or failing to start an analysis?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Yes. There is a line saying not enough free disk space to start a new analysis, and it repeats every time a job is picked up.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: That matches. Sandbox seems to hold back new analyses when free space gets too low, so the queue stalls. I have not confirmed the exact threshold, so I will check the documentation and our cleanup guidance.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Can I just delete the old VM images and reports to free up space? I am worried about removing something Sandbox still needs.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Please don't delete anything by hand yet. First send me a breakdown of folder sizes on the data drive, so we can see what is using the space, and I will send you the documented cleanup steps.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Okay. I can export the folder sizes today. The oldest reports go back about fourteen months.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Great. Once I have that, I will confirm which items are safe to remove and what to check when the queue starts moving again. Thanks, Hannah.
